endpoints.POST /session: Create or reuse anonymous identity; returns user and mode.
endpoints.GET /bootstrap: user, conversations[], actions[30], mode, symptom_definitions[12], stats
endpoints.GET /conversations/{id}: conversation + turns[] including user_text, response, feedback, trace
endpoints.DELETE /conversations/{id}: {deleted: true}; cascades turns, feedback, plans, state events and request records
endpoints.POST /conversations/{id}/turns: {text,expected_version,idempotency_key} -> turn; same key/payload replays original response
endpoints.POST /plans: {turn_id} -> plan (201); one plan per turn, urgent-support route cannot be added
endpoints.GET /settings: mode, storage, catalog_version, catalog_status, api_key_configured, features, algorithm_status, history_scope, full_name; no secrets
endpoints.GET /export: downloadable user-scoped JSON containing conversations, all turn snapshots, state history and plans

state.version: integer; message commit and manual correction both increment

ranking: 30 unique action IDs, title, score in [0,1], reason; independent urgent-support route returns []
pending: Duplicate in-flight request returns 202 {status:'pending',request_id}; retry identical payload. A different request while pending receives 409.

model.online: server environment configuration only; structured extraction and reply generation, local fallback is traceable

timestamps: UTC ISO-8601; clients render local time
